snippet.title: Light Dude Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Light Dude Demo is officially out in less than 10 days on March 27 on Steam! The full game releases in June 2026.
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3055110/Light_Dude/

The level hides when you move in this skill-driven tactical action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill.

The game is solo-developed by me, hope you guys like it!
